潮騒が遠く響く、午後の静寂。<br>清掃を終えたばかりの砂浜は、陽光を跳ね返して:
The distant sound of waves fills the quiet afternoon.
The freshly cleaned beach sparkles white under the sun.
ふぅ……みんなでゴミを拾ったお陰で砂浜がすっかり綺麗になったな。<br>これでま:
Phew... Thanks to everyone picking up trash,
the beach is spotless. Now we can all swim freely again.
んっ？ 今、何か聞こえたような……: Hm? Did I just hear something...?
声のする岩陰へと急ぐと、そこにはおよそ現実のものとは思えない、<br>無惨で、か:
Rushing to the rocks, I found a surreal sight—
both pitiful and strangely erotic.
